turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm cooking for my boyfriend's parents for the first time and I'm torn on the main course.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A few choices coming. No comments till the end, please.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A chicken pie, which is homely and safe, and I can make the pastry the day before.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Paella, it's my best dish and it looks impressive, but his mum doesn't really like seafood.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A big lamb tagine with couscous, which smells amazing but I've only cooked it once before.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything on my list. What would you go for?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The chicken pie is the safest bet, it's comforting and you can prep it ahead. The paella is your strongest dish, but a seafood problem is a real risk with his mum. The tagine sounds wonderful, though I'd rather not try a nearly new recipe on the big night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? I sit at a desk all day and my back is killing me. Are there exercises that help?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes. Bridges, bird dogs and gentle cat cow stretches strengthen and loosen your back. A few minutes a day helps.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: On your hands and knees, you stretch one arm forward and the opposite leg back, hold for a few seconds, then switch.
